name: D&D 5e (SRD)
description: Fifth edition fantasy from the System Reference Document 5.1: six abilities, proficiency bonus, d20 attacks against Armor Class, saving throws against a DC, spell slots and 4d6-drop-lowest character creation. Includes the SRD 5.2.1 and SRD 5.1 creature stat blocks with an NPC sheet and the SRD 5.2.1 encounter XP budget.
